units.lua_targets_us: device median wall time of the probe's lua_arith, lua_table, lua_string, lua_calls kernels, microseconds
units.reference_host_us: fastest in-runtime calibration kernel time on the reference host, microseconds
units.reference_lua_factor: Lua factor at which native factors and fixed corrections were fitted
units.calibration_bias: script-context / calibration-context kernel cost ratio measured on the reference host
units._fixed_us: signed device microseconds added per binding call

check.probe_change_since_device_run: adds guarded emu_cost_stats capture only; kernel and timing code unchanged
check.ratio: device median / emulator median of per-repeat medians

unchecked_known_gaps.midi_send_burst_1 / midi_send_burst_16 /: emulator 1.6-4x slower: host wake-up cost after idle is scaled with the Lua work

limitations: Models Lua-thread execution and MIDI/grid/screen binding cost only; screen rendering thread, JACK/crone audio load, SD storage latency and memory pressure are not modelled.
Timing is observed at the native MIDI boundary in the emulator and at a Lua send wrapper on the device.
Emulator JACK runs the dummy driver at 1024 frames; the device uses ALSA at 128 frames.
Mods loaded on the device are absent from emulator sessions.
